title: Display clusters in principal-component coordinates
description: You plot projected observations and centroids on the same axes.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You center the centroids with the standardized data mean and project them using comps.T. C_proj supplies centroid coordinates for the figure.
You select rows of Z by cluster label and plot each group separately. Each scatter call adds a matching cluster label.

steps.question: How does the chart distinguish centroids from the observation points?
steps.answer: The centroid scatter uses large X markers. Observation points use smaller markers.

steps.description: You display observations and centroids along PC1 and PC2, the first two principal-component axes. The legend identifies the observation groups by cluster number.
